add_userdata_to_body: add key-value user data to a pybullet body using addUserData
get_userdata_by_id: retrieve a user data value by its ID using getUserData
get_userdata_id_by_key: get the user data ID for a given key on a body using getUserDataId
remove_userdata_entry: remove a user data entry from a body using removeUserData
sync_userdata_cache: sync the local user data cache with the bullet server using syncUserData
